title: New country sign-in
description: A user authenticated from a region not observed in the previous 90 days.

title: Endpoint protection disabled
description: Endpoint-security service was disabled by a local administrator account.

title: Multiple failed admin logins
description: Five failed administrator sign-in attempts were detected from an unusual workstation.

title: Unusual outbound data transfer
description: File-server traffic exceeded its normal outbound baseline and connected to an unrecognized IP address.

title: Suspicious PowerShell execution
description: Encoded PowerShell was launched by an Office process on a finance workstation.

title: Credential stuffing attempt against VPN
description: A high volume of failed sign-in attempts from multiple IP addresses targeted privileged VPN accounts.
